data.name: HtmlEditorDescription
data.value: WYSIWYG editor and its HTML source: a command toolbar the page picks, reorders or extends, sanitised paste, history, the HTML it binds, and what a host brings through extensions (notes, proofreading, suggestions, tables, mail templates).

data.name: HtmlEditorSettingsDescription
data.value: The toolbar is a public list of commands: every setting below changes it.

data.name: HtmlEditorToolbarRows
data.value: Limit the toolbar to two rows

data.name: HtmlEditorModeDescription
data.value: The formatted document or its HTML source; the Source button of the toolbar does the same.

data.name: HtmlEditorToolbarDescription
data.value: The complete toolbar of the package, an essential selection, or the same commands in another order.

data.name: HtmlEditorCommandDescription
data.value: A command added by the page, at the end of the toolbar: it inserts the signature at the caret.

data.name: HtmlEditorCustomToolsDescription
data.value: Two commands labelled in text, after the toolbar: a signature and a reference added at the end of the text.

data.name: HtmlEditorBoldDescription
data.value: Shows or removes the Bold command, whatever the toolbar.

data.name: HtmlEditorItalicDescription
data.value: Shows or removes the Italic command, whatever the toolbar.

data.name: HtmlEditorSubscriptDescription
data.value: Shows or removes the Subscript command, whatever the toolbar.

data.name: HtmlEditorSuperscriptDescription
data.value: Shows or removes the Superscript command, whatever the toolbar.

data.name: HtmlEditorIndentDescription
data.value: Shows or removes the command that increases the indent.

data.name: HtmlEditorOutdentDescription
data.value: Shows or removes the command that decreases the indent.

data.name: HtmlEditorPreviewDescription
data.value: In the source face, renders the sanitised markup under the text area.

data.name: HtmlEditorDisabledDescription
data.value: The document, the source and every command are locked.

data.name: HtmlEditorRowsDescription
data.value: Lines of the source and minimum height of the document.

data.name: HtmlEditorCharactersDescription
data.value: The host gives the set of letters and receives the character chosen: the first palette types it into a text area, the second only lists what it handed out.

data.name: HtmlEditorRenderedDescription
data.value: The value shown outside the editor, in an omni-rich-text container that carries alignments and sizes.

data.name: HtmlEditorHostCommandsDescription
data.value: The default toolbar ends with commands of the host: one inserts a block, one rewrites the whole value, one inserts a reference at the caret. The second editor shows the same value in its source face.

data.name: HtmlEditorAnnotatedDescription
data.value: The editor keeps the markup of the host (notes in asides, data attributes), reports where the caret is and enables the table commands inside a cell. Click a note to tick it.

data.name: HtmlEditorExtensionDescription
data.value: An extension brings a note command (Ctrl+Shift+N), a click that marks a note as read, a context menu, a proofreader and text suggestions (Tab accepts). The second editor runs the same proofreader on a text that starts read-only.

data.name: HtmlEditorMailDescription
data.value: Subject, body and variables: a variable button writes its token at the caret, the Preview tab shows the mail as a mail client receives it, and Send a test hands it to the application. Nothing is sent here.

data.name: DocumentEditorDescription
data.value: A light word processor: a page, styles and sizes, lists, alignment, a table, the word count and export to HTML or text.

data.name: DocumentEditorSettingsDescription
data.value: What the bar under the page shows, and what the page accepts.

data.name: DocumentEditorStatusBarDescription
data.value: Words and characters, updated while typing, next to the HTML and plain text downloads.

data.name: DocumentEditorReadOnlyDescription
data.value: The page and the toolbar are locked, exports stay available.

data.name: DocumentEditorFileNameDescription
data.value: Name given to the downloaded files, without the extension.

data.name: CodeEditorDescription
data.value: Code editor: language, read only, line numbers, wrapping, Ctrl+click links and a script-free plain text engine. Monaco is served by the host from its own folder; this site does not serve it, so the page runs the plain text engine.

data.name: CodeEditorSettingsDescription
data.value: Every setting applies live, without recreating the editor.

data.name: CodeEditorLanguageDescription
data.value: The highlighting of the editor; the sample changes with the language.

data.name: CodeEditorReadOnlyDescription
data.value: The code can be read and selected but not changed.

data.name: CodeEditorWordWrapDescription
data.value: Long lines wrap instead of scrolling.

data.name: CodeEditorLinksDescription
data.value: In YAML, the name after pipeline: becomes a Ctrl+click link, reported to the page.

data.name: CodeEditorHeightDescription
data.value: Height of the editor, in rem.

data.name: CodeReadingDescription
data.value: Read only code, command output with colours, and side by side or unified differences.

data.name: CodeReadingExcerptDescription
data.value: The viewer numbers its lines from line 120, as in the source file; the highlighted line counts the same way.

data.name: CodeReadingDiffExpandedDescription
data.value: The files of the unified diff open expanded; turned off, only their header shows.

data.name: CodeReadingAnsiDescription
data.value: AnsiMode draws the colour sequences (Render), removes the codes (Hide) or keeps the raw text (Raw); copying takes the codes only in Raw.

data.name: CodeReadingNavigationDescription
data.value: The viewer's own bar (ShowNavigation), then a comparison filling its frame under a bar owned by the page. The plain text engine keeps the previous and next buttons disabled: they work once Monaco is mounted.
